quests.question: The baker had just pulled the loaves from the oven, still warm and crisp; they were _____.
quests.explanation: Loaves straight from the oven, warm and crisp, are newly made, so fresh fits; stale contradicts.

quests.question: Fog crept over the empty graveyard and an owl hooted in the dark; it felt _____.
quests.explanation: Fog, an empty graveyard and a hooting owl in the dark create fear, so spooky fits.

quests.question: He lectured everyone about punctuality while arriving late every day; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Lecturing others about punctuality while being late himself is saying one thing and doing another, which is hypocritical.

quests.question: Kites danced, curtains flapped and hair blew about; the beach was _____.
quests.explanation: Dancing kites, flapping curtains and blowing hair show moving air, so breezy fits; still contradicts.

quests.question: 'I'm the best on the team, no question,' he said _____, flexing his arms.
quests.explanation: Calling himself the best 'no question' and flexing his arms is bragging: boastfully.

quests.question: The cat crept along the wall without a sound toward the bird, moving _____.
quests.explanation: Creeping without a sound toward the bird shows secret, quiet movement, so stealthily fits.

quests.question: 'Let me explain this slowly, dear,' he said to the engineer; his tone was _____.
quests.explanation: Explaining slowly and saying 'dear' to a professional shows talking down to her: patronising.

quests.question: She waved off the intern's suggestion without hearing it; her reaction was _____.
quests.explanation: Waving off a suggestion unheard shows refusing to consider it, so dismissive fits.

quests.question: Whenever the child begged for sweets, his grandmother gave in; she is far too _____.
quests.explanation: Always giving in when a child begs shows too much leniency, so indulgent fits; strict contradicts.

quests.question: Facing the angry crowd, the councillor hid behind aides and refused to speak; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Hiding from an angry crowd and refusing to speak shows a lack of courage: pusillanimous.

quests.question: The bread had been open for a week, hard and dry; it tasted _____.
quests.explanation: A week open and hard and dry shows the bread has lost its freshness, so stale fits; fresh and warm contradict.

quests.question: Hearing about her lost job, he sat beside her, nodded and listened _____.
quests.explanation: Sitting beside her, nodding and listening shows he shared her feelings: sympathetically.

quests.question: She watched the surgery video without turning away or blinking; her gaze was _____.
quests.explanation: Watching without turning away or blinking shows steady firmness, so unflinching fits.

quests.question: A first-year student with no money, she applied to ten top universities, aiming _____.
quests.explanation: Applying to ten top universities with no money shows bold, high aims: ambitiously.

quests.question: The soup was smooth, thick and rich with a swirl of milk; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Smooth, thick and rich with milk describes a velvety texture: creamy; watery contradicts.

quests.question: When the result was announced, the whole crowd leapt up and cheered _____.
quests.explanation: Leaping up and cheering at the result shows great joy, so jubilantly fits; mournfully contradicts.

quests.question: The new recruit jumped at every sound and spoke only in whispers; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Jumping at every sound and whispering show nervous fear, so timorous fits; intrepid contradicts.

quests.question: Nothing they offered, begged or threatened could soften her opposition; she was _____.
quests.explanation: Offers, begging and threats could not soften her, so she could not be appeased: implacable.

quests.question: Through every defeat and storm, the fans stayed loyal and strong; they were _____ supporters.
quests.explanation: Staying loyal through every defeat and storm shows firm, dependable support, so stalwart fits; fickle contradicts.

quests.question: He polished the car until it sparkled and reflected the sky; it looked _____.
quests.explanation: Sparkling and reflecting the sky are marks of a glossy surface, so shiny fits; dull contradicts.

quests.question: Passed over for promotion again, she clapped for the winner _____.
quests.explanation: Being passed over again suggests bitterness behind the applause, so resentfully fits.

quests.question: Every bite of the apple made a loud snap; it was _____.
quests.explanation: A loud snap at every bite shows a firm, crisp texture, so crunchy fits; mushy contradicts.

quests.question: The table rocked whenever anyone leaned on it because one leg was short; it was _____.
quests.explanation: A table rocking because one leg is short is unsteady, so wobbly fits; stable contradicts.

quests.question: Looking at the burnt cake he had been so sure about, he shook his head and smiled _____.
quests.explanation: Shaking his head and smiling at his own burnt cake shows wry, regretful humour, so ruefully fits; gleefully doesn't.

quests.question: Beaten, broke and ill, she refused to give up; her spirit was _____.
quests.explanation: Refusing to give up when beaten, broke and ill shows a spirit that cannot be defeated, so indomitable fits.

quests.question: Left in the rain for years, the gate creaked and flaked orange; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Years in the rain and orange flakes show corroded metal, so rusty fits; gleaming contradicts.

quests.question: His hands were black with oil and his overalls smeared with dirt; he looked _____.
quests.explanation: Black hands and smeared overalls show he was covered in dirt, so grimy fits; spotless and clean contradict.

quests.question: He asked the same question at every meeting for a year until someone answered; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Asking the same question for a whole year shows stubborn persistence: pertinacious.

quests.question: The mule stood in the road and would not move despite pushing, pulling or carrots; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Refusing to move despite pushing, pulling and carrots shows stubborn resistance: obstinate.

quests.question: Seeing demand for umbrellas on rainy days, he set up a stall by the station, thinking _____.
quests.explanation: Spotting demand and setting up where buyers pass shows smart business sense: shrewdly.
